name: Windswept
description: Caught in the gale of the Windward Tunnels: much faster on your feet, and every blow sends things flying.

name: Swole
description:
Fresh off a hundred squats.
Hits harder, and every hit feeds you.

name: Toned
description:
The burn is settling in.
Recovery comes a little easier.

name: Second Wind
description:
Your greens are still working.
Health trickles back in.

name: Purified
description:
Clean inside and out.
Your own healing lands harder.

name: Radiant
description:
You are glowing, literally.
Every hit heals you and the people around you.

name: Zesty
description:
A little spring left in the step.
TP trickles back.

name: Bulked
description:
Built like a loaf.
Hard to hurt, hard to move.

name: Sturdy
description:
Still solid.
A touch tougher, a touch bigger.

name: Milk Drunk
description:
A gallon of Dragon Juice, metabolized.
Spells come fast and cheap.

name: Lactose Tolerant
description:
Strong bones.
MP trickles back and magic stings less.

name: Sugar High
description:
Everything is fast and nothing can touch you.
For about fifteen seconds.

name: Sugar Crash
description:
The comedown.
Slower, unluckier, and it was worth it.

name: Stilled
description: Held in place, unable to strike, yet nothing like sealed.

name: Lethargic
description: Moving at a crawl.

name: Still Devotion
description: A votary left standing still hardens, until it moves again.

name: Hardened
description: Hardened by stillness: more DEF and MDF with every stack.

name: Scrambled
description: Scrambled to zero: nothing gets in while he lurches.

name: Embraced
description: Held fast in his arms, and drained.

name: Overreached
description: Overreached: open, and held where he landed.

name: Fraying
description: The scramble frays, and he lurches faster.
